technique_name: How can digital wallets be used to improve financial inclusion?
description: Digital wallets are an effective way to improve financial inclusion. By using digital wallets, users can access financial services with minimal paperwork and without the need for a bank account. This makes it easier for marginalized populations, including low-income individuals, unbanked people, and refugees, to access financial services.
